summary.li1: Audio and video of consultations: end-to-end encrypted. Neither we nor LiveKit Cloud (media provider) can hear or see them.
summary.li2: Clinical notes: encrypted in your browser before upload. The key derives from your password. We do not have a copy of the key.
summary.li3: Patient's personal notes (when an account exists): encrypted with the patient's key. The professional does not see them. The server does not see them.
summary.li4: We do not record consultations, we do not use your data to train AI, we do not sell data to third parties.
summary.li5: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time.
summary.note: The legal and technical details are in the sections below.

s1.p1: Espaço Prelúdio ("Platform") is operated by [Legal Entity to be defined], CNPJ [to be defined], headquartered at [address], acting as controller of the registration data of professionals and patients, and as processor of the clinical data entered by professionals (who are controllers of their own records, under CFP Resolution no. 1/2019 and equivalents).
s1.p3: This Policy is governed by the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law no. 13,709/2018), with special attention to sensitive personal health data (Art. 5, II and Art. 11), by the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law no. 12,965/2014), by the Consumer Protection Code (Law no. 8,078/1990) when applicable, and by the resolutions of professional councils (CFP no. 11/2018, CFM no. 2.314/2022, etc.).

s2.h: 2. What data we collect and why
s2.li1a: Name, email, CRP/CRM number, specialty, optional biography.
s2.li1b: Legal basis: contract performance (Art. 7, V, LGPD) — necessary for providing the service.
s2.li1c: Purpose: identification, authentication, display on the public page (when authorized), validation of professional qualification.
s2.h2: 2.2. Patient registration data (when they opt to create an account)
s2.li2c: Purpose: allow the patient to keep their own notes between consultations.
s2.li2d: The account is optional: the patient may join consultations only through the link sent, without registration.
s2.li3a: Clinical notes, observations, any record content entered by the professional.
s2.li3b: The patient's personal notes, when they choose to write them and have an account.
s2.li3c: Legal basis: Art. 11, II, "f" (protection of health, in a procedure performed by health professionals).
s2.li3d: Technical treatment: this data is encrypted in the browser with a key derived from the holder's password (PBKDF2/AES-GCM). The server stores only the ciphertext and the initialization vector. We have no way to decrypt it.
s2.li4a: They travel in real time via LiveKit Cloud with end-to-end encryption (E2EE).
s2.li4b: They are not recorded by us, by LiveKit, or stored in any media. The E2EE key is generated per consultation, known only to the clients (professional and patient) and discarded at the end of the session.
s2.li5a: IP address, browser agent, timestamps of login and start/end of consultation.
s2.li5b: Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX, LGPD) and compliance with legal obligation (Art. 7, II) regarding connection logs (Internet Civil Framework, Art. 15: 6 months).
s2.li6a: Collected and processed by a partner payment gateway (e.g., MercadoPago).
s2.li6b: We do not store complete card data. We receive only tokens and the status of the transaction.

s3.h: 3. What we do not do with your data
s3.li1: We do not access the content of clinical notes. By cryptographic design, we cannot.
s3.li2: We do not record audio, video, screen or text typed during consultations.
s3.li3: We do not use health data to train artificial intelligence models.
s3.li4: We do not sell, rent or assign personal data to third parties for advertising purposes.
s3.li5: We do not use advertising tracking cookies or social network pixels on authenticated pages.

s4.li1: Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ on all connections.
s4.li2: Encryption at rest (clinical data): AES-GCM 256-bit with key derived by PBKDF2 (200,000 iterations, SHA-256). The key never travels.
s4.li3: E2EE for media: Encoded Transforms via LiveKit, with a room key generated per consultation.
s4.li4: Authentication: Firebase Authentication with a minimum password of 10 characters; rate limiting against brute-force.
s4.li5: Environment segregation: test database isolated from production database.
s4.li6: Audit: logging of sensitive events (login, creation/closing of consultation, access to records).
s4.li7: Minimization principle: we collect only what is necessary for the service.
s4.p: Although we employ recognized security practices, no system is absolutely impenetrable. In the event of a security incident that may pose relevant risk to data subjects, we will notify those affected and the ANPD within a reasonable period, in accordance with Art. 48 of the LGPD.

s5.h: 5. Sharing with processors and third parties
s5.p1: To operate the Platform, we contract third-party services that process data on our behalf ("processors"). We select partners based in jurisdictions with an adequate level of data protection or with standard contractual protection clauses:
s5.li1: Firebase / Google Cloud — authentication and database (Firestore). Servers in region southamerica-east1 (São Paulo) or equivalent. Clinical data arrives only encrypted.
s5.li2: LiveKit Cloud — real-time media forwarding with E2EE. Does not store recordings.
s5.li5: Payment gateway (when applicable) — processing of financial transactions.
s5.p2: We do not share personal data with third parties for marketing, advertising or profiling purposes. We share with public authorities only when required by court order or formal administrative request, within legal limits.

s6.p: Some processors (LiveKit Cloud, Firebase) may process data on servers outside Brazil. When that happens, we transfer it based on one of the hypotheses of Art. 33 of the LGPD — preferably to a country with an adequate level of protection, or under standard contractual clauses. Sensitive clinical data always travels encrypted, and in no case in plaintext.

s7.li1: Registration data: while the account is active + minimum tax/regulatory retention period applicable after termination.
s7.li2: Records (under professional ownership): 20 years after the last consultation, in accordance with CFP Resolution no. 1/2019 and counterparts.
s7.li3: Patient's personal notes: while the patient's account exists; deleted upon termination.
s7.li4: Connection logs: 6 months, in accordance with the Internet Civil Framework (Art. 15).
s7.li5: Record access audit logs: retained for the same period as the record to which they refer.

s8.h: 8. Your rights as a data subject
s8.p1: Under the terms of Art. 18 of the LGPD, you may, at any time:
s8.li1: Confirm the existence of processing and access your data.
s8.li2: Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
s8.li3: Request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed in non-compliance.
s8.li5: Revoke consent — when that is the legal basis used.
s8.li6: Object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interest.
s8.li7: Be informed about the processors with whom we share your data.
s8.li8: File a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
s8.p2: Important: clinical notes under the custody of the professional (record) may be subject to the legal retention period of the CFP/CFM even after a deletion request. In that case, the data may be anonymized or kept blocked for the sole purpose of complying with a legal obligation, under Art. 16, I, of the LGPD.
s8.p3: To exercise your rights, write to dpo@preludiojogos.com. We will respond within 15 days.

s9.p: We use only cookies strictly necessary for authentication and the functioning of the Platform (session, interface preferences). We do not use advertising tracking cookies, social network pixels or analytics tools that profile the user.

s10.p: Care for minors on the Platform requires authorization and active participation of a legal guardian, under the clinical judgment of the professional. Account registration on the Platform is restricted to those aged 18 or older.

s11.p: We may update this Policy to reflect changes in the service, in legislation or in market practices. Relevant changes will be communicated at least 15 days in advance by email or notice on the Platform itself.
